Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 12-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Centre Administrator post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Centre Administrator post is 12th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Centre Administrator role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in Law, Social Work, Sociology, Social Science, or Psychology. Additionally, a minimum of 5 years of experience in women-related government or non-government projects is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The age limit varies by category: UR Male (37 years), OBC/EBC Male/Female (40 years), UR Female (40 years), and SC/ST Male/Female (42 years).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Centre Administrator position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General, OBC, SC, ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for the OSC Khagaria Centre Administrator recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it out, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Centre Administrator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Centre Administrator post, which is reserved for women.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an interview and the preparation of a merit list based on the candidates' qualifications and performance.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents, including a photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of One Stop Center Khagaria, which is khagaria.nic.in.
